dandiset_id.Description: Unique ID for the source dataset at the DANDI archive.

url.Description: URL for the source dataset at the DANDI archive.

bican_subprogram.Description: The name of the BICAN subprogram to which the source dataset belongs.

grant_number.Description: The grant number for the funding associated with the source dataset.

number_of_cells.Description: The total number of cells in the source dataset at DANDI. Note that the source dataset contains additional cells that are not included in this publication dataset.
